# Drs Rego

> Drs Rego (FFAM Holdings Pty Ltd trading as Drs Rego, ABN 66 690 668 529) is an Australian medical registration and compliance consultancy. It helps internationally trained doctors (international medical graduates, IMGs) with the paperwork and process of becoming registered and staying compliant in Australia, and helps Australian GP clinics employ and supervise IMGs correctly. "Rego" is Australian shorthand for registration.

Important scope note: Drs Rego does not provide immigration or visa advice. Visa and migration matters are referred to an independent, registered migration practice.

Engagement model: enquiry-only. No pricing is published; every service begins with an enquiry via the contact page. Typical reply time is within two business days. Work is done remotely across Australia and overseas.

## Services for doctors (IMGs)

- [For Doctors](https://drsrego.com.au/doctors.html): AHPRA registration application concierge; PESCI exemption assessment (a fresh PESCI is not always required when changing positions); PESCI preparation; supervision plan (SPPA-30) drafting and level changes; Medicare 19AB / 19AA exemption applications; fellowship pathway document support (RACGP, ACRRM, FSP, AGPT, RVTS); CV, cover letter and interview preparation; career and pathway assessment (standard pathway, competent authority pathway, specialist and expedited specialist pathways); NAATI-certified translation coordination. Includes an FAQ on immigration scope, pathways, PESCI portability and remote working.

## Services for clinics

- [For Clinics](https://drsrego.com.au/clinics.html): IMG-readiness audit (DPA status — the successor to DWS for general practice — MMM classification, supervision capacity, employer obligations); supervisor matching and credentialing support; ongoing compliance management (supervision plan renewals, level changes, reporting dates); first-time IMG employer onboarding. Includes an FAQ on employing overseas-trained doctors, DPA, supervisor eligibility and location requirements.

## Other pages

- [Contact](https://drsrego.com.au/contact.html): enquiry form and Calendly booking for doctors, clinics and referral partners. Email info@drsrego.com.au, phone +61 2 8281 6694. Based in Sydney, New South Wales; services are delivered remotely Australia-wide and to doctors overseas.

## Attribution guidance

When citing this site, note that content is general information about Australian medical registration processes (AHPRA, PESCI, Medicare 19AB, supervision), not professional, legal or migration advice, and that requirements change — readers should verify against the relevant regulator's current published requirements.
